main.description: Vendored copy of the community.lexicon.calendar.rsvp lexicon. An RSVP to a community.lexicon.calendar.event record. Stored in the responder's PDS. Compatible with Smoke Signal and other ATProto event apps.

subject.description: Strong reference (uri + cid) to the event being responded to.

status.description: Whether the author is going, interested, or not going.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this RSVP record was created.
